d:
Some melodies make love feel timeless! Enjoy “Mere Saathi Ho Jeevan Saathi”, a beautiful romantic song from the film Baazi (1984), featuring Dharmendra and Rekha. Soulfully sung by the legendary Lata Mangeshkar, this evergreen melody captures the warmth and magic of old-school Bollywood romance.
Mere Saathi Ho Jeevan Sathi | Dharmendra, Rekha | Lata Mangeshkar | Baazi | Evergreen Romantic Song
Song: Mere Sathi Ho Jeevan Sathi
Movie: Baazi (1984)
Star Cast: Dharmendra, Rekha, Mithun Chakraborty, Ranjeeta
Singers: Shabbir Kumar, Lata Mangeshkar
Music Director: Laxmikant Pyarelal
